scopeNote: Track this permit application and its conditions. Permanent residence requires a separate eligible pathway and decision. Community averages combine applications within this guide and are not IRCC processing estimates.

relatedPathways.label: Canadian Experience Class
relatedPathways.description: Qualifying Canadian work may support CEC eligibility. Work gained while studying full-time does not count toward the CEC minimum. Meeting eligibility does not guarantee an invitation.

relatedPathways.label: Provincial nominee programs
relatedPathways.description: Check the province’s current stream rules, selection process and settlement-intent requirements. A permit alone does not qualify you for nomination or guarantee PR.

steps.title: Check your PGWP eligibility
steps.description: Check your institution, program, study history and completion requirements. A PGWP is generally available only once; exceptions and special program rules must be checked with IRCC.

preparationChecklist.text: Check the minimum program length (normally 8 months or 900 hours for eligible Quebec programs), full-time study with the final-semester exception, leave and distance-learning rules.

steps.title: Confirm language and field requirements
steps.description: For current applications, degree graduates and other university graduates generally need CLB/NCLC 7 in all four skills; other college or non-university graduates generally need 5. Degree graduates have no field-of-study requirement. Check IRCC’s program-specific exceptions.

requiredDocuments.title: Approved language test result
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Eligible field-of-study evidence
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Check your study-permit application date and six-digit CIP code if a field requirement applies.
Follow the separate rules for flight-school graduates.

steps.title: Collect graduation records
steps.description: Get official proof that you completed your program and prepare the other documents on your personalized checklist.

requiredDocuments.title: Completion letter
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Official transcript
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

requiredDocuments.title: Passport
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Check that your records show completion.

steps.title: Check the deadline and your status
steps.description: Apply within 180 days of confirmation that you completed your program. This deadline does not extend your immigration status. Review restoration or outside-Canada options if your study permit has expired.

requiredDocuments.title: Current status documents
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Record when the school confirmed completion.

commonMistakes: Do not treat the 180-day application window as authorization to stay or work.

steps.title: Apply for your PGWP
steps.description: Follow the instructions for applicants inside or outside Canada, upload evidence and pay applicable fees. PGWP applications cannot be made at a port of entry.

requiredDocuments.title: PGWP application package
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Retain the application confirmation and receipts.

steps.title: Check work authorization while waiting
steps.description: Work while waiting is allowed only when IRCC’s conditions are met, including a valid study permit when applying, program completion and eligible off-campus work without exceeding permitted hours. Otherwise, wait for authorization.

preparationChecklist.text: Confirm every condition before starting or continuing work.
Stop working if IRCC refuses the application.

steps.title: Respond to IRCC requests
steps.description: Complete any requested biometrics, medical exam or additional evidence within the stated deadline.

requiredDocuments.title: Requested evidence
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

steps.title: Receive and review your PGWP
steps.description: Follow your approval and permit-issuance instructions. Check expiry, occupation restrictions and the separate visa/eTA requirements for travel.

requiredDocuments.title: Approval and work permit
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Verify your permit before relying on its work authorization.

steps.title: Review future work and PR options
steps.description: Track permit expiry and qualifying work history. Use the separate Express Entry or PNP roadmap only after choosing a route whose requirements fit your situation.

preparationChecklist.text: Keep employer letters, duties, dates and pay records.
Review future status before your permit expires.
